aiRelay.dsp-selected: System-wide AI is off because Classic DSP is selected.
aiRelay.model-unsupported: System-wide AI requires Spleeter; using DSP.
aiRelay.unavailable: Spleeter or the app-owned runtime is unavailable; using DSP.
aiRelay.fell-behind: AI fell behind; using DSP. Toggle processing to retry.
aiRelay.failed: AI processing failed; using DSP. Check the model/runtime and toggle processing to retry.
aiRelay.apo-active: The physical APO is active and uses DSP. AI applies to the relay only.

aiPlayer.delay: Always uses Spleeter, independently of the player model. Adds about 12 seconds of delay: video and games go out of sync. Toggling this restarts the relay.
aiPlayer.mdxOffline: MDX cannot keep up with real time on some CPUs. File playback waits while it prepares more audio; system-wide AI requires Spleeter.
aiPlayer.notReady: AI is unavailable. Install and verify the selected model and the app-owned ONNX Runtime to enable it.
aiPlayer.runtimeMissing: The model is installed, but the app-owned inference runtime could not be loaded.
aiPlayer.changesStop: Changing the engine or active model stops playback. Open the file again to use the new selection.
aiPlayer.playerOnly: Auto uses AI for files when ready, otherwise DSP. System-wide AI needs its own opt-in; physical APOs still use DSP.

playback.title: Play files in Voxveil
playback.description: Open MP3, WAV, FLAC, or Ogg Vorbis files and process only their audio before sending it to a physical output.
playback.outputDescription: Processed audio is sent only to this output.
playback.onlyFile: Only the file opened here is processed. Other apps continue to play normally.

home.title: Hear the mix, your way.
home.description: Reduce vocals from device audio locally, with direct control over isolation quality and latency.

processing.backendComponentRequired: The Windows system-audio APO is not attached to the active output. Use Install component below to open the bundled administrator installer. Development packages may ask for the audio driver Hardware ID and topology reference string.
processing.backendUnsupported: System-audio processing is not implemented for this platform build yet.
processing.backendFaulted: The audio backend failed to initialize. Processing was disabled so device audio remains unmodified.
processing.backendRoutingRequired: The Windows audio component needs attention before processing can start.

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: Classic DSP works without a model. Optional AI separation can improve isolation when a commercially cleared local model is installed.
engine.dspDescription: Ultra-light center and spectral vocal suppression.
engine.aiDescription: Local two-stem separation with models bundled in Windows packages.
engine.licenseRule: Only approved, hash-pinned models are bundled. Fallback downloads require explicit consent.
engine.bundledStorage: Included as part of this application; cannot be removed. No download is needed.
engine.modelStorage: If bundled files are missing, you can download this model to Voxveil application data on this device.
engine.consentDescription: Voxveil will download {{name}} (~{{size}} MB) only after you agree. The file is stored in application data and verified before installation.
engine.networkNotice: This one-time download contacts the model host. No audio, analytics, telemetry, or diagnostics are uploaded.
engine.consentAgreement: I agree to download and use this third-party model under its {{license}} license.

modelError.status: Model status could not be read.
modelError.download: Model download or integrity verification failed.

engine.runtimePending: Model installed. AI inference is not enabled in this build yet.

apps.title: Apps
apps.description: Process the complete device mix or select individual applications. Communication audio remains bypassed by default.

routing.title: Routing
routing.description: Send one processed stream to physical playback, the virtual endpoint, or both without running separation twice.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Voxveil keeps configuration, language resources, processing and diagnostics on this device.
settings.languageDescription: Bundled locally. No translation service is contacted.
settings.privacyDescription: No analytics, telemetry, crash upload or cloud audio processing.
settings.appearanceDescription: Choose how Voxveil follows your display.
